symptom: ako/mxcli#859 (rehearsal W1): `create or modify view entity` on an existing view entity reported "Modified view entity" and wrote the domain model on every re-run; the script's following `grant` wrote the access rule back, and a script without that grant silently left the view entity with no access rules.
cause: execCreateViewEntity rebuilt the entity from the statement alone and swapped it in (keeping only ID, SourceObjectID and documentation), so everything the statement has no words for — access rules first — was dropped; the persistent-entity path had already moved to mergeDeclaredOntoStoredEntity for exactly this.
fix: The modify branch starts from a copy of the stored entity and overwrites only what the statement declares (name, location, persistable, attributes, source, source document, OQL, documentation carry), then prunes member accesses of dropped attributes.
insight: A fix applied to one sibling path (persistent entity) leaves the class open in the others: enumerate every `create or modify` path that rebuilds a stored object from its statement — the view entity path was the persistent entity's #1 bug a second time.
